column1: # The systems ES shows on the MiSTer, and how mister-launch.sh starts their games. One a line, tab separated:
# ES name (Batocera's) | full name | folder under games/ (several "|" apart: the first that exists; "@" first: under
# the SD card's root) | extensions | core (as an MGL names it) | set name ("-": none) | MGL file: method (f: file,
# s: disc; cd32: Minimig's CD32, the disc in its configuration), delay, index | the core's reset held after the game
# is loaded (delay:hold, seconds; "-": none) | platform, as ES's PlatformIds knows it ("-": the ES name) | the
# theme's name for the system's art ("-": the ES name).
# The values follow the MiSTer cores' own (the same Zaparoo and mrext launch with).
